target_audience: Euler EV Dealership Staff (Sales, Finance, Operations)
emotional_tone: Clinical precision, high-tech, functional beauty, and authoritative.

app_structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex flex-col border-r border-zinc-200 bg-white
app_structure.topbar: sticky top-0 z-40 flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center gap-x-4 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

layouts.spacing: Dense and compact for data tables (py-2 px-3 cells), generous for layout structural elements (p-6, p-8 containers).

kpi_card.container: bg-white rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200
kpi_card.title: text-sm font-medium text-zinc-500

table.container: bg-white rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm

badge.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold ring-1 ring-inset

button.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow hover:bg-blue-700 focus-visible:outline-blue-600 transition-colors
button.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-50 transition-colors

forms.input: block w-full rounded-md border-0 py-1.5 text-zinc-900 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-inset ring-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-inset focus:ring-blue-600 sm:text-sm sm:leading-6
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium leading-6 text-zinc-900 mb-1

overlays.side_drawer: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 z-50 w-full max-w-md bg-white shadow-2xl ring-1 ring-zinc-200

motion.modal_enter: ease-out duration-300 opacity-0 scale-95 to opacity-100 scale-100

formatting.currency: Use Indian Rupee (₹) format with lakh/crore grouping using Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'INR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }). Examples: ₹ 1,50,000, ₹ 12,00,000.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons (weight: 'regular' for sidebar/UI, 'fill' for active states). Extremely legible for dense data tables.

image_urls.usage: Use for Price Master or vehicle model thumbnails in the dashboard.

image_urls.description: Electric vehicle charger plugged into car
image_urls.usage: Use as a subtle overlay or header image for EV related statistics.
Use for empty states in tables or activity logs.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a DATA-DENSE operations console. Do not use giant paddings in tables. Use py-2.5 px-4 for table cells.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body and data.
Implement the 'Bento Grid Protocol - High Density Grid' for the main dashboard. Utilize col-span logic effectively.
For all currency representations, STRICTLY use the Indian Lakh/Crore grouping system (e.g., ₹ 1,50,000).
Use side-drawers (max-w-md or max-w-2xl) for complex forms like 'Convert to Booking', 'Price Structure Editor', and 'Lead Detail View', instead of navigating to separate pages.
Implement 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions) for robust testing.
The UI is purely Light Mode focused, built for clarity under fluorescent dealership lights. Use sharp, high-contrast borders and pure white cards on an off-white background.
All status badges should be small, fully rounded pills with subtle background tints and strong text contrast.
Ensure the Sidebar navigation has an active state that uses the primary Cobalt Blue color (#1D4ED8) with a subtle background tint.
Include an Activity Log module, a Delivery Tracker with status chips (Insurance/Registration/Invoice/RC/PDI), and a complex Price Structure editor.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align data and forms for rapid scanning.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, especially for sticky headers and side panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-md button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
